scope: Sanitized static snapshot of the bounded two-table Snowflake-backed Power BI model
evidence: Snowflake imported 15 dimension rows and 33 fact rows into the two-table semantic model.
TMDL accepted seven DAX measures with zero problems.
An explicit Power BI Service refresh advanced the workspace timestamp.
A post-refresh DAX query returned one row with seven columns in 957.5 ms.
The saved report reopened in reading view with four cards and a source-by-date table.
limits: This public page is a checked-in snapshot, not a connection to the private Power BI workspace.
It contains aggregate measures only, with no application history, recipient data, URLs, employer rows, or source-level records.
The broader six-table design was not deployed and is not presented here as live.
The live refresh used the Power BI Service web action, not the service-principal REST helper.
